♪Alex Morgan Guitar

Learn Guitar from Alex Morgan

Start your musical journey today. Whether you're a complete beginner or looking to refine your skills, I offer personalized guitar lessons tailored to your goals and pace.

Get Started

Flexible Pricing Plans

Choose the lesson package that works best for you. All packages include personalized instruction and practice materials.

Starter

per 30-minute lesson
  • One-on-one instruction
  • 30 minutes per session
  • Flexible scheduling
  • Beginner fundamentals
  • Digital chord charts

Popular: Standard

per 60-minute lesson
  • One-on-one instruction
  • 60 minutes per session
  • Flexible scheduling
  • All skill levels welcome
  • Custom lesson plans
  • Digital resources library
  • Progress tracking

Premium

per 90-minute lesson
  • One-on-one instruction
  • 90 minutes per session
  • Priority scheduling
  • Advanced technique focus
  • Song arrangement help
  • Recording & feedback
  • Exclusive masterclasses

Special offer: Book a package of 4 lessons and receive 10% off your first month.

Why Choose Alex Morgan Guitar?

Personalized Approach

Every student learns differently. I create customized lesson plans based on your musical goals, learning style, and favorite genres—whether that's rock, folk, classical, jazz, or blues.

All Ages Welcome

From children as young as 7 to adults and seniors, I work with students of all ages and experience levels. It's never too late to start learning guitar.

Proven Teaching Method

With over 12 years of teaching experience, I've developed a method that makes learning fun, manageable, and results-oriented. You'll see progress from your first lesson.

Flexible & Convenient

Lessons are available online via video call or in-person at my studio in downtown Portland. Choose the time that works best for your schedule.

Performance Ready

Want to play at open mics or jam with friends? I'll help you build confidence and repertoire to perform music you love.

Ongoing Support

Get email and text support between lessons, access to my practice guides, and video demonstrations to help you master techniques at home.

What My Students Say

"I was terrified to pick up a guitar, but Alex made me feel comfortable from day one. Six months later, I'm playing complete songs and actually enjoying it. Highly recommended!"

— Sarah Chen, Student since 2023

"Alex's teaching style is encouraging without being pushy. He listens to what I want to learn and tailors every lesson. I look forward to my sessions every week."

— Marcus Rodriguez, Age 42

"My daughter has been taking lessons for a year now. She's gone from knowing nothing to performing at her school talent show. Alex is patient and passionate about music."

— Jennifer Park, Parent

Ready to Learn? Get in Touch

Fill out the form below and I'll respond within 24 hours to discuss your goals and schedule your first lesson.

Can't wait? Call or email me directly:

📧 hello@alexmorganguitar.com
